_**Agent (copilot/claude-haiku-4.5)**_

The user is asking "چرا؟" which means "Why?" in Persian. They're asking why `vueuse` package is not found even after switching to the official npm registry.

Looking at the error:
```
npm error 404 Not Found - GET https://registry.npmjs.org/vueuse - Not found
```

The problem is that the package name in `package.json` is `"vueuse": "^10.7.2"` but this might be a typo. Looking at the devDependencies, there's `"@vueuse/core": "^10.7.2"` which is the actual package.

The issue is likely that:
1. There is no package called `vueuse` in npm registry
2. There IS a package called `@vueuse/core` (scoped package)
3. The user probably meant to install `@vueuse/core` instead of `vueuse`

Let me verify this and fix it.
